title: Ramayana to release in nearly 40 languages worldwide; Namit Malhotra and team mount an unprecedented overseas release
raw_summary:
Less than a month is left for the release of Ramayana, and the excitement is steadily building. Yesterday, the makers finally announced that the much-awaited film will release in cinemas worldwide on November 5. They also revealed that advance bookings will commence on Dussehra, October 20. Meanwhile, the makers are working round the clock to ensure an unprecedented release in overseas markets.

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama, “Producer Namit Malhotra and the core team of Ramayana are determined to make it the biggest release ever for an Indian film. They have been working towards this goal for a long time. The film's promotion at CinemaCon 2026 and San Diego Comic-Con was a step in that direction. Getting Sony Pictures on board for international distribution was also a huge shot in the arm.”

The source continued, “To make the film accessible and appealing to audiences across the globe, Ramayana has been dubbed in nearly 40 languages. As a result, viewers across the world will be able to experience the film in all its glory in a language they understand, without having to rely on subtitles. This is the first time an Indian film has been dubbed on such a massive scale. The complete list of languages in which the film has been dubbed will be unveiled in a week or two.”

Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. It is directed by Nitesh Tiwari of Dangal (2016) fame and produced by Namit Malhotra. The music is composed by A R Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

The mythological epic is being made as a two-part saga, with the first instalment arriving in cinemas on November 5, 2026, that is, in the Diwali week. The second part is scheduled for release during Diwali 2027.

title: FIR register against Imran Khan and others over August Kranti Maidan protest: REPORT
raw_summary:
Mumbai Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) against actor Imran Khan, his girlfriend Lekha Washington and several others following their detention during a protest at August Kranti Maidan on Saturday, October 10. The demonstration was organised in support of the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) protest in Delhi, which called for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The FIR was registered at Gamdevi police station under Sections 223, 126(2), 189(2), 189(3) and 189(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), according to reports. The provisions cited in the case relate to disobedience of orders issued by public servants, wrongful restraint and offences associated with unlawful assembly. The complaint was filed by police personnel following the gathering, which took place amid heightened security arrangements in the area.

According to reports, more than 400 people were detained during the protest, with some accounts putting the number at around 600 across Mumbai. Those detained included Imran, Lekha and Imran’s cousin, Zayn Marie Khan. They were released later that night.

Ahead of the demonstration, police personnel had barricaded roads surrounding August Kranti Maidan and deployed additional staff to prevent the gathering from proceeding. The detentions took place as authorities maintained security in the area.

Following his detention, Imran took to Instagram to share a selfie from inside a police van. The actor accompanied the picture with the caption, “Apparently I'm going for a drive.”

Lekha also shared updates on social media following the detention. She said she did not know where the police were taking them. After their release, she alleged that the police were not allowing them to return home or arrange a vehicle. She later reassured her followers that they were safe and on their way home.

The Mumbai protest was held in solidarity with the CJP’s demonstration in Delhi, where protesters were also detained during a major police operation. The movement has been demanding Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over allegations concerning the revision of electoral rolls.

With the registration of the FIR, the legal proceedings against Imran, Lekha and the other individuals named in the case have become a fresh development following Saturday’s demonstration. Further details about the case and any subsequent police action remain awaited.

raw_summary:
Arjun Rampal has embarked on an exciting new journey with Billionaire, which commenced with a traditional mahurat puja on the auspicious occasion of Navratri.

The big-scale business drama, directed by Hansal Mehta and Robbie Grewal, marks the first-ever collaboration between the two acclaimed filmmakers. Produced by Prabhleen Sandhu under the banner of Almighty Motion Picture, the series is set to begin its extensive 45-day shooting schedule in the United Kingdom from November 15.

Arjun Rampal also took to his Instagram handle to share his joy and excitement about the new beginning.

The actor is currently enjoying the enormous success of the Dhurandhar duology. Directed by Aditya Dhar, Dhurandhar, the first film, released in December 2025 and became a blockbuster after taking just a decent start at the box office. The second film, Dhurandhar The Revenge, which released in March this year, turned out to be a blockbuster of mammoth proportions and the highest grossing Hindi film till date by earning over Rs. 1000 crores at the domestic box office itself. Arjun’s act as the ISI (Inter-Services Intelligence) chief Major Iqbal was also highly praised.

Written by Anubhav Chopra and Shantanu Sagara, with dialogues by Karan Vyas, Billionaire promises a gripping tale of ambition, power and the high-stakes world of business.

The series will premiere exclusively on Prime Video.

Mahaveer Jain Films, which has been backing several exciting projects across genres, is all set to present an ambitious Kannada sci-fi social thriller, Lambodhara 2.0. Bollywood Hungama has exclusively learned that the film, directed by acclaimed Kannada filmmaker Simple Suni, will release in cinemas on November 20, 2026, in Kannada and Hindi. Set in a world increasingly dominated by artificial intelligence and digital validation, Lambodhara 2.0 raises an interesting question: Can technology truly make human beings happy? Blending suspense, humour, entertainment and thought-provoking ideas, the film explores the intersection of artificial intelligence, human emotions, happiness and free will.

Meanwhile, Mahaveer Jain has an interesting slate of films lined up. He has also announced RamBola, which will be directed by Vishal Chaturvedi of Hanuman Ansh fame. title: Salman Khan gears up for 50-day close-combat final schedule of Monster, deets inside
raw_summary:
Superstar Salman Khan is all set to get onto intense work mode as his upcoming action drama Monster enters its final and most intense stretch of filming. Directed by Vamshi Paidipally, the Pan-India project is officially charging towards the finish line, with the superstar gearing up for a 50-day schedule dedicated entirely to high-stakes, close-quarter combat sequences.

The team has set up base at a studio in Mira Road to film these action sequences. Moving away from slick, glossy effects, the makers are aiming for a raw and grounded action experience, with Salman at the centre of intense, hand-to-hand combat against his opponents.

Ever since principal photography began in Mumbai in mid-April 2026, Monster has been mounted on a massive scale. The film completed a packed six-week schedule in Goregaon this August, featuring large-scale action set-pieces, crowd sequences and an elaborate Afghan village setup. This was followed by a focused 10-day combat training schedule in Mumbai in September.

Salman Khan is balancing his Bigg Boss 20 commitments with the physically demanding action schedule, keping the film firmly on track for a November wrap. With filming entering its final lap, the team will move directly into post-production to prepare for its Eid 2027 theatrical release.

Produced by Dil Raju under the banner of Sri Venkateswara Creations, Monster stars Salman Khan alongside an ensemble cast featuring Nayanthara, Jackie Shroff, Arvind Swamy, Rahul Dev, Ronit Roy and Seema Biswas.

title: Imran Khan detained by Mumbai Police during protest at August Kranti Maidan; says, “I am here to see why people’s voices are being suppressed”
raw_summary:
Actor Imran Khan was detained by Mumbai Police while participating in a protest at August Kranti Maidan in Mumbai on October 10. The protest was held in solidarity with the Cockroach Janata Party’s (CJP) protest in Delhi, which called for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Following his detention, Imran shared a selfie from inside the police van on Instagram and captioned it, “Apparently I’m going for a drive.”

Before being detained, the actor spoke about his reasons for participating in the protest, clarifying that he was present as a citizen and was not representing any organization. He told the news agency ANI, “I don't have demands. I am here as a citizen, as someone who lives in this city. I am here to see why freedom of movement is being restricted—why people’s voices are being suppressed. That is why I am here. I am not in a position to make demands of anyone. Nor am I part of any organization. I am just here as a representative.”

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Imran Khan (@imrankhan)

Imran Khan, known for films such as Jaane Tu... Ya Jaane Na and I Hate Luv Storys, has largely stayed away from the limelight in recent years. But he had participated in the protests held in July this year for the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan as the Education Minister following the leak of NEET question paper.

title: Gunmaaster G9: Emraan Hashmi starrer gets a major overseas distribution boost ahead of November 27 release
raw_summary:
Emraan Hashmi starrer Gunmaaster G9 has added another development to its distribution plans ahead of its theatrical release, with Phars Films acquiring the film’s overseas theatrical distribution rights. The financial details of the deal have not been disclosed. The acquisition comes as the action romance, directed by Aditya Datt, prepares for a worldwide theatrical release on November 27, 2026.

The development was confirmed by trade analyst Taran Adarsh, who shared the news on social media. Announcing the deal, he wrote, “PHARS FILM ACQUIRES OVERSEAS THEATRICAL DISTRIBUTION RIGHTS OF 'GUNMAASTER G9'... #PharsFilm, one of the leading names in Overseas distribution, has acquired the Overseas theatrical distribution rights of #GunmaasterG9, starring #EmraanHashmi.”

PHARS FILM ACQUIRES *OVERSEAS* THEATRICAL DISTRIBUTION RIGHTS OF 'GUNMAASTER G9'... #PharsFilm, one of the leading names in Overseas distribution, has acquired the *Overseas* theatrical distribution rights of #GunmaasterG9, starring #EmraanHashmi. Earlier, #PENMarudhar had acquired the *all-India* theatrical distribution rights of the film.

#GunmaasterG9 marks yet another collaboration between #EmraanHashmi, music composer #HimeshReshammiya, and director #AdityaDatt, who first joined forces in 2005.

Directed by Aditya Datt, #GunmaasterG9 stars #EmraanHashmi, #GeneliaDeshmukh, #AparshaktiKhurana, and #AbhishekSingh.

#GunmaasterG9 will release worldwide in cinemas on 27 Nov 2026... The film is an SRE Studio LLP production.

#G9 | #Gunmaaster | #HimeshReshammiyaMelodies

Phars Films has an established presence in international film distribution, with a focus on overseas markets, including the Middle East. Its association with Gunmaaster G9 gives the film a distribution partner for territories outside India as the makers work towards its planned theatrical rollout.

The overseas acquisition follows PEN Marudhar coming on board as the film’s all-India distributor. With the two distribution partners handling the domestic and international markets, respectively, the film is building its distribution network ahead of its scheduled release. However, the financial terms of the overseas deal have not been made public.

Teaser and Himesh Reshammiya collaboration add to the buzz around Gunmaaster G9

The distribution announcement comes amid the film’s ongoing promotional campaign. The teaser and the release of its first song, ‘Afsaana Banaaya Aapne’, have introduced audiences to different aspects of the project. The song brings Emraan Hashmi together with composer-singer Himesh Reshammiya, adding a musical element to the film’s promotional outreach.

With action, romance and music forming part of its appeal, Gunmaaster G9 is gearing up for its theatrical arrival. The overseas rights acquisition marks another step in the film’s preparations for a release across domestic and international markets, although audience reception and box-office performance will ultimately be determined after its release.

Cast, crew and release details

Gunmaaster G9 stars Emraan Hashmi, Genelia D’Souza, Aparshakti Khurana and Abhishek Singh. The film is produced by Deepak Mukut, Hunar Mukut and Sangeeta Ahir, and presented by Soham Rockstar Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. Directed by Aditya Datt, the action romance is a production of SRE Studio LLP.

The film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on November 27, 2026. Phars Films will handle its overseas theatrical distribution, while PEN Marudhar will oversee distribution across India.

With its release date approaching, the film’s distribution partnerships and promotional campaign are expected to remain key developments as Gunmaaster G9 prepares to reach audiences in India and overseas.

title: Ajay Devgn begins shooting for Chauhaan in Kargil; returns to Ladakh 23 years after LOC: Kargil
raw_summary:
Ajay Devgn delivered a blockbuster this year with Drishyam The Conclusion, which was released during the lucrative October 2 weekend. Interestingly, the actor is gearing up for another release around the same period next year, Chauhaan. Bollywood Hungama has learned that Ajay recently began shooting for the war drama in Kargil, Ladakh.

A source from Ladakh told Bollywood Hungama, “Ajay Devgn is shooting for Chauhaan in Kargil. He arrived here a few days ago and has already begun filming. Some key scenes will be shot in this picturesque town. The makers had obtained the necessary permissions in advance and have made elaborate arrangements to ensure that the shoot goes smoothly.”

The source continued, “It’s quite cold here in Kargil, and the weather will surely add an authentic touch to the scenes of Chauhaan.”

Interestingly, this is not the first time Ajay Devgn is shooting in Ladakh. He had earlier filmed some crucial scenes for J P Dutta’s war film LOC: Kargil (2003) in the mountainous region. At that time, Ladakh was part of the erstwhile state of Jammu & Kashmir. It became a separate Union Territory in 2019, with Leh and Kargil as its two capitals.

Chauhaan is directed by Neeraj Yadav and produced by Jyoti Deshpande, Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma under Jio Studios and Colour Yellow Productions. The film was announced on June 25, 2026, on the birth anniversary of the late action director Veeru Devgan, Ajay Devgn’s father. It is scheduled to release in cinemas on October 1, 2027.

The announcement video featured the song ‘Jumma Chumma De De’ playing in the background and ended with the dialogue, “Pathaanon se kehna, Chauhaan aa raha hai.” The film marks Ajay Devgn’s first collaboration with filmmaker Aanand L Rai. Jio Studios serves as both presenter and producer on the project.

title: Ranveer Singh brings home a Rs. 1.95 crore electric luxury sedan; all you need to know about his BMW i7
raw_summary:
Bollywood star Ranveer Singh has added a new luxury car to his garage, with the actor taking delivery of the BMW i7 50 xDrive, the all-electric version of the German automaker’s flagship 7 Series sedan. The luxury electric car is priced at Rs. 1.95 crore (ex-showroom), making it a significant addition to the actor’s already impressive collection of automobiles.

The acquisition comes shortly after Ranveer was unveiled as BMW India’s brand ambassador and introduced the company’s latest 7 Series range at a launch event in New Delhi in September. The actor’s association with the brand now gets an interesting personal touch, with the star bringing home one of its flagship electric offerings.

The BMW i7 50 xDrive M Sport combines the presence and comfort expected from a flagship luxury sedan with the benefits of an all-electric powertrain. The model produces 455 hp and 600 Nm of torque, with a claimed 0-100 kmph acceleration time of 5.5 seconds. It features a 112.5 kWh battery pack and offers a claimed driving range of up to 728 km on the WLTP cycle.

The car also places considerable emphasis on passenger comfort and in-cabin technology. Its features include a large rear-seat entertainment screen, a premium Bowers & Wilkins sound system, executive lounge seating and an upgraded infotainment setup. The new i7 is locally manufactured at BMW Group’s Chennai facility, making India the only country outside Germany to produce the electric flagship.

For Ranveer, whose larger-than-life personality often extends to his automobile choices, the i7 represents a move towards electric luxury without compromising on performance or road presence. With its imposing design, technology-led cabin and all-electric credentials, the BMW is a fitting addition to the actor’s collection.

title: Ronit Roy leases Andheri west office space for Rs 1.39 crores over five years
raw_summary:
Actor Ronit Roy has leased a commercial office space in Mumbai’s Andheri West for a total rent of approximately Rs 1.39 crores over a five-year period. The transaction adds to the actor’s reported real estate holdings in the city, where he also owns a residential apartment in Versova.

According to a Business Standard report citing property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix, the office measures 950 square feet and is situated on the fourth floor of Vastu Prestige, near City Mall in Andheri West.

The leave-and-licence agreement was registered on June 12, with the lease commencing on July 10. The agreement will remain valid until July 9, 2031, covering a total tenure of 60 months.

As per the report, the commercial premises have been leased to Kerawi Care (OPC) Private Limited, represented by its director, Vandana Verma. Roy is listed as the licensor in the agreement, while the company is the licensee.

The office space carries a monthly rent of Rs 2.1 lakhs, while the security deposit has been set at Rs 6.5 lakhs. The total rent payable over the five-year period amounts to Rs 1,39,24,584. The agreement also provides for an annual rent escalation of 5%, along with a lock-in period of 36 months for both parties.

The terms further specify the division of property-related expenses between the parties. Roy, as the licensor, will be responsible for property taxes, maintenance charges and non-occupancy charges. Meanwhile, the tenant will pay electricity bills according to actual consumption. The report also noted that the agreement does not mention any designated car parking space for the office.

This is not the actor’s first reported real estate transaction in Mumbai. According to a Hindustan Times report citing property registration documents accessed by IndexTap.com, Roy purchased a 4,258-square-foot apartment in the Lodha Versova project in 2024 for Rs 18.94 crores. The property reportedly came with four car parking spaces.

A separate Economic Times report published in September 2026 stated that Roy and his family reside in Versova, where they expanded their home over the years by acquiring adjoining apartments.

Apart from his acting career, Roy is known for his roles as Mihir Virani in Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi and Rishabh Bajaj in Kasautii Zindagii Kay. He also owns Ace Security and Protection, a security agency that has reportedly served several prominent Bollywood personalities, including Amitabh Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan and Aamir Khan. The agency also provided protection to Saif Ali Khan following the attack on the actor.

title: Nana Patekar death: Goa Police register “unnatural death” case, to begin further enquiry
raw_summary:
Veteran actor Nana Patekar was cremated with full state honours at his Donje farmhouse in Pune on Thursday night, October 8, following his death at the age of 75. Meanwhile, Panaji Police have registered an unnatural death case under Section 194 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and further enquiry into the circumstances surrounding his death is underway.

According to police records, Nana Patekar was brought dead to the casualty ward of Manipal Hospital in Bambolim from his residence at Ocean Park, Dona Paula, Goa. The enquiry is being led by PSI Nitin Naik.

The registration of an unnatural death case is part of the police procedure to examine the circumstances surrounding a death. The case registration, by itself, does not establish any wrongdoing. Further details are awaited as the enquiry progresses.

title: Meezaan Jafri headlines Killer Jeans' Genes of India campaign
raw_summary:
Killer Jeans, one of India’s first homegrown denim brands, is changing the conversation around denim fashion in the country through its Genes of India campaign, with actor Meezaan Jafri as the face of the brand. The campaign looks at how denim has become a part of everyday dressing across India, and how each region, city and generation styles it in its own way.

Denim is now one of the most versatile and widely worn categories in Indian fashion. It is part of wardrobes across age groups and occasions, and it continues to influence how younger consumers dress for work, travel, social settings and celebrations. Genes of India builds on this shift, presenting denim as a shared part of Indian style, from Kashmir to Kanyakumari.

Meezaan Jafri, as brand ambassador, connects with an audience that sees denim as a core part of personal style and not as a casual alternative. His styling reflects the fits and combinations that younger consumers are choosing today. “Denim is something almost everyone in India relates to, whatever their background or city,” said Meezaan Jafri. “What I like about Genes of India is that it doesn’t ask people to dress a certain way. It recognises that everyone wears denim differently, and that is what makes it ours.”

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Killer Jeans (@killerjeansofficial)

The latest addition to the Killer line-up, Neo Flare brings a contemporary perspective to the classic flare silhouette. Designed to sit slim through the hip, thigh and knee, the fit gradually opens below the knee to create a longer, leaner profile. Neo Flare brings a fresh dimension to everyday denim and pairs effortlessly with everything from sneakers to boots.

The collection is complemented by Selvedge Denim, known for its distinctive character, texture and craftsmanship, alongside Killer’s range of fabric innovations. K-Tech Denim offers a lighter feel, SoftPro Denim delivers a softer hand-feel, while Cool Core Denim is designed to provide comfort across changing weather conditions. Together, these innovations reflect Killer’s focus on combining contemporary denim design with fit, functionality and comfort.

“Denim has always been something I’ve felt people can make their own. In India, that feels even more interesting because the way you wear it changes from city to city, from generation to generation, and from person to person. That’s what drew me to Genes of India; it’s not about one definition of denim, but about all the different ways we style it, live in it and make it part of who we are” said Hemant Jain, Joint Managing Director, Kewal Kiran Clothing Limited.

Killer’s contribution to the category begins with its products. The brand designs for Indian consumers, with attention to fit, comfort and finish, and places weight on Indian manufacturing and the craftsmanship that goes into making denim. Through Genes of India, it aims to bring that work into focus and to support a stronger domestic denim category, where consumers can find quality, trend-relevant options made in India.

Killer believes Indian denim has significant room to grow, driven by rising fashion awareness, a greater willingness to experiment and demand for quality, locally made products.

title: Hanuman Ansh, Cocktail 2 create tourism BOOM: Kainchi Dham witnesses MASSIVE crowds; Italy bookings jump 38%
raw_summary:
Films have often influenced the travel plans of moviegoers, inspiring them to visit destinations they have admired on the big screen. Switzerland became a dream destination for many Indians after its picturesque locations were showcased in Yash Chopra's films. Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai (2000) encouraged viewers to explore New Zealand, while Spain found a place on travellers' wish lists after Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara (2011). Similarly, 3 Idiots (2009) made Ladakh's Pangong Lake a must-visit destination. In recent times, two films have once again demonstrated the power of cinema in boosting tourism – Hanuman Ansh and Cocktail 2.

Last weekend, videos and pictures emerged of tourists and devotees thronging Kainchi Dham near Nainital, Uttarakhand. The surge in footfalls has been partly attributed to the sleeper blockbuster Hanuman Ansh, which is based on the life of Neeb Karori Baba, whose ashram is situated at Kainchi Dham.

A recent report in Bombay Times, published before the October 2 weekend rush, quoted Sanjeev Kumar, General Manager, Naukuchia House, Naukuchiatal – IHCL SeleQtions, as saying, “The interest around Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba and Kainchi Dham has renewed attention on the spiritual landscape of Kumaon. Film-led interest can encourage travellers to look beyond the screen and discover the local culture, faith, food, people and landscape. That is when storytelling becomes meaningful for a destination – when a film sparks curiosity and leads to a more personal journey.”

However, the sudden popularity has also brought its share of problems. ThePrint published a detailed report on how locals are struggling to cope with the influx of tourists in the post-Hanuman Ansh era. The report revealed that rooms which normally cost Rs. 2,000-3,000 per night were being offered for as much as Rs. 7,000 during the recent rush. The massive crowds also led to traffic congestion and put pressure on local infrastructure.

This is also an example of the flip side of film tourism, where a destination becomes so popular that it struggles to accommodate the influx of visitors. The situation has prompted authorities to consider stricter measures. According to reports, the administration is planning to introduce a registration system for visitors, initially on weekends, to regulate the crowds and ensure a smoother experience for devotees.

On the other hand, Italy has once again caught the imagination of Indian moviegoers, and the credit partly goes to Cocktail 2, starring Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna. A significant portion of the film's first half is set in picturesque Italian locations such as Catania, Noto, Siracusa, Castellammare del Golfo, Avola and Milan. These places have been beautifully captured on the big screen, giving viewers yet another reason to consider Italy for their next holiday.

According to the Bombay Times report, Aloke Bajpai, Group CEO, ixigo, revealed, “Since Cocktail 2 was released, bookings on our site to and from Italy are up 38% YoY.”

He further stated, “According to Great Indian Travel Index report, released last year, YoY bookings on ixigo to cities across the Northeast grew sharply, Dimapur +77%, Agartala +48%, and Guwahati and Imphal +44% each, with shows like The Family Man helping bring these destinations into the spotlight. We are seeing the same internationally. Sicily, featured in The White Lotus, The Odyssey and Cocktail 2, is a great example.”

The developments once again underline the influence of cinema beyond the box office. While films can introduce audiences to destinations they may never have considered visiting, the growing popularity of these places also raises questions about whether local infrastructure is equipped to handle the sudden influx. Hanuman Ansh and Cocktail 2 are two contrasting examples of this phenomenon, showing how the magic of the movies can translate into real-world travel, economic opportunities and, at times, unexpected challenges.

title: Awarapan 2 gets OTT premiere: Emraan Hashmi starrer starts streaming on Prime Video
raw_summary:
On October 9, 2026, Prime Video announced the exclusive global streaming premiere of Vishesh Bhatt’s Awarapan 2, the Hindi action drama that brought back Emraan Hashmi as one of his most-remembered characters. The return of Shivam comes nearly two decades after Awarapan, directed by Mohit Suri, became a defining film for a generation of viewers, with its brooding protagonist, poignant storytelling, and soulful music leaving a lasting imprint on popular culture.

Directed by Nitin Kakkar, Awarapan 2 builds on that familiarity, while taking Shivam into a next chapter, blending the emotional intensity of his story with high-octane action and the nostalgic musical sensibility audiences remember from the era. The film also stars Disha Patani, Shabana Azmi, Puran Gabbi, Vijayant Kohli, and Suvinder Vicky in pivotal roles, and weaves romance, action, and drama against the backdrop of the criminal underworld.

Vishesh Bhatt brings Awarapan 2, the second chapter of the blockbuster franchise. In a remote Rajasthan village, Shivam Pandit grieves at his beloved’s grave, questioning his purpose, his life. Having withdrawn from the world of crime and carrying the guilt of a past he cannot alter, he has resigned himself to a life in solitude. Then, an unexpected bond gives him a glimpse of something he had long thought beyond his reach - a reason to care, to hope, and perhaps to live differently.

  A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin)

But fate has other plans. Drawn into Bangkok’s cartel war, Shivam is forced back into the darkness he had left behind. Amid violence, betrayal and an unexpected chance in love, he finds himself responsible for something beyond himself. As the lives of those he has come to care for become entwined with his own, Shivam must confront the choices that brought him here - and decide what he is willing to fight for.
